verdict.rationale: BVNK documents payment rules (POST /payment/v1/rules) that link a fiat virtual account to a blockchain address so incoming funds are automatically on-ramped and sent without manual action. Webhooks, including scheduled ledger report delivery, push automated event notifications that downstream systems can act on. These are domain-specific standing rules, not a general automation builder, and anything beyond them requires the user's own webhook-driven code. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation/workflow configuration, scheduling or triggers beyond fiat-to-crypto rules, monitoring/management of running automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
